environment.mode: Playwright headless system Chrome on Windows
environment.renderer: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti (0x00002C05) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

timing.summary: median of per-round FPS and nearest-rank interval percentiles, interleaved A/B with reversed test order
timing.scroll: 4800 CSS px mouse gesture at 2400 CSS px/s, down from top/middle and up from bottom
timing.pointer: one synthetic pointermove per real rAF for 2 s while table is stationary
timing.rawPresentationOffsetUnit: microseconds from the first input mark
timing.windowedEvents: scroll events where the inline viewport-filter override was already set when sampled

tableGlassPointerUpdates.metric: calls per second to glass drawing during a pointer gesture

activeScrollMaterial.region: all physical pixels strictly inside the scrollport bounds, with foreground rows and text
activeScrollMaterial.method: Hold the active scroll phase at ten actual CSS offsets. Compare full, active, then repeated full screenshots while the same rows are visible. Count raw RGB changes without subtracting the control.
